_about: Z09: zone world simulation (main loop, player tick, mobs, spawns, drops, scripts). Read from the zone send sites; client-facing ones checked against the 2016 client handler list. Field names are the 2017 PDB names where the 2016 code agrees.

0x240E.name: NC_BAT_HPCHANGE_CMD
fields: current HP minus vt 0x65c, floored at 0
0x240E.notes: sent from the player tick whenever the value differs from the last sent (+0x172d8)

0x245F.name: NC_BAT_LPCHANGE_CMD
0x245F.notes: player tick, on change; also sent to every object targeting the player (so_ply_Send2WhoTargetMe)

0x244A.name: NC_BAT_REALLYKILL_CMD
0x244A.basis: zone ShineMob::so_Routine FUN_0056baa0, ShineNPC::so_Routine FUN_0056a9e0, ShineMob::so_mob_SendReallyKill FUN_00553760; client FUN_004a28e0; pdb2016 lists 0x244A under two names, NC_BAT_PKINPKFIELD_WMS_CMD (Zone/WM enum) and NC_BAT_REALLYKILL_CMD (alt, struct {dead, attacker} = this layout); the zone sends the REALLYKILL layout (R2)
0x244A.notes: 2017 PDB alias of 0x244A (the zone→WM direction is NC_BAT_PKINPKFIELD_WMS_CMD, Z03). Sent once to sight when the mob's mode becomes 3.

0x2076.name: NC_ACT_ANIMATION_LEVEL_CHANGE_CMD
fields: MobConditionServer level; client stores it at char+0xb60

0x6C0B.name: NC_SCENARIO_OBJTYPECHANGE_CMD
fields: 5 acts as a mob, 4 as an NPC (inferred)

0x748D.name: NC_GUILD_MOBGUILD_CMD
0x748D.basis: zone ShineMob::so_mob_SetGuildRegNum FUN_00476110, ShineMob::mb_SendMyGuildInfo FUN_00475a80; client FUN_004ba6b0; field names from pdb2016 PROTO_NC_GUILD_MOBGUILD_CMD (R2)

0x201F.name: NC_ACT_SOMEONESHOUT_CMD
0x201F.basis: zone ShineMob::so_Shout FUN_00459250, ShineMobileObject::so_Shout FUN_00459080; client handler reads offset 1 as u16 for mobs (re-data/client-handlers.json 0x201f); 2017 PDB PROTO_NC_ACT_SOMEONESHOUT_CMD agrees
fields: 0 for mobs; link count for players
union: charID (player name, or a script-given name) / mobID (vt 0x708) when isMob
bits GMColor:1@0 (vt 0xef4), isMob:1@1 (pdb2016; mob version: speaker string empty); other bits stale in the mob version
text, then itemLinkDataCount × 0x67-byte item links (player version only)
0x201F.notes: to the whole map instance (target 0xFFFF) or one object. The mob version sends len + 0x1A bytes including the opcode, one stale byte more than the packet (Z09-B10).

0x1C0E.name: NC_BRIEFINFO_BRIEFINFODELETE_CMD
0x1C0E.basis: zone static packet `briefinfodelete` built by its dynamic initializer FUN_006951d0 (buffer 0x74df98, opcode 0x1C0E, payload pointer DAT_0074e028); sent by AxialListBriefDeleteAtMove::ali_Work FUN_004bdfe0 (ShineMobileObject::smo_OldObjectDelete FUN_004be0d0) and AxialListBriefDeleteAllOfRange::ali_Work FUN_005535c0 (player vt 0xdc4 / 0xdd0); client FUN_004b99f0
fields: handle of the object that left the receiver's sight
0x1C0E.notes: corrects Z02 §5 ('no zone code sends 0x1C0E'); client queues the handle in CharMgr.m_kmapDeletedChar (pdb2017) unless char+0x9be, removes minimap/decal/KQ marks

0x2049.name: NC_ACT_REINFORCE_RUN_CMD
0x2049.basis: zone ShinePlayer::smo_ply_ReinforceRun FUN_00566ab0 (player vt 0xe98, called by ShineMobileObject::so_MoveByServer FUN_00569510 with cmd 0x49); client FUN_004aa210
0x2049.notes: to the moved player only; client runs the main character there when its ground is free (only while main char +0x20 or +0x2c > 0)

0x204D.name: NC_ACT_REINFORCE_WALK_CMD
0x204D.basis: zone ShinePlayer::smo_ply_ReinforceRun FUN_00566ab0 with cmd 0x4D (no 2016 caller passes 0x4D, see Z09 §9.3); client FUN_004aa320; no PROTO struct in pdb2016 (R2)

0x204A.name: NC_ACT_REINFORCE_STOP_CMD
0x204A.basis: zone ShinePlayer::smo_ply_ReinforceStopHere FUN_00456ef0 (player vt 0xa50); client FUN_00499f10
0x204A.notes: to the player only, after every server-side stop (mm_Step stop, block-check rollback, teleport)

0x2069.name: NC_ACT_REINFORCERELOC_CMD
0x2069.basis: zone ShineMobileObject::so_ReinforceMove FUN_00459600; client FUN_004a4180; no PROTO struct in pdb2016 (R2)
fields: bit 0 = 'backwards' (facing kept: the client turns towards `from`); other bits stale g_buf content
0x2069.notes: no PDB struct; layout = PROTO_NC_ACT_SOMEONEMOVEWALK_CMD. Broadcast to sight (incl. the mover); used for knock-back / pull (Z03) and StaBodyForce shots

0x1C0A.name: NC_BRIEFINFO_DROPEDITEM_CMD
0x1C0A.basis: zone ctor BriefInformationDropItem::BriefInformationDropItem FUN_005492d0 (header 0x1C0A, len 0x11) at drop+0x167, filled by ShineDropItem::so_ItemDrop FUN_0052a7a0; sent by ShineDropItem::so_SendMyBriefInfo FUN_00555280 (drop vt 0x4c8) from ShineObject::so_drpitm_BriefInfo FUN_00567ff0; PDB PROTO_NC_BRIEFINFO_DROPEDITEM_CMD size 0xf; pdb2016 agrees (R2)
fields: drop position after the spiral placement
bits rareness:3@0 (always 0), looting:1@3 (pdb2016) = the receiving player may pick it (drop vt 0x538 so_drpitm_CanLootingBitSet, recomputed per receiver before each send)
0x1C0A.notes: one shared buffer per drop: the pickable bit is rewritten for each receiver just before the send; re-broadcast to the sight when the owner-only time ends and when a dice winner fails to pick

0x303B.name: NC_ITEM_DICE_GAME_CMD
0x303B.basis: zone ShineDropItem::so_DiceItemPickInit FUN_00531020; client GameFrameWork::On_NC_ITEM_DICE_GAME_CMD FUN_0049c530
fields: BelongDice.shn DiceTimeLimit (15), default 15 when the table is empty
0x303B.notes: to every party/raid member within 1000 units of the picker (2..20 players); the client opens RollingDiceWin with this item and timer

0x303E.name: NC_ITEM_DICE_GAME_START_CMD
0x303E.notes: to every participant on the roller's map who is still in the party/raid; client prints '%s rolled the dice and the result was %d.' or '%s decided to give up the chance to roll the dice.'

0x303F.name: NC_ITEM_DICE_GAME_RESULT_CMD
0x303F.basis: zone ShineDropItem::sd_DiceGameSendMsgResult FUN_0052ee60 from ShineDropItem::sd_DiceGameResult FUN_00531470; client FUN_004b2750
fields: drop+0x195 item ID at send time
0x303F.notes: to every participant still in the party/raid; client: 0x2008 → '%s acquired the %s item by rolling %d with the dice.' if PickItemID is a known item, else the error text

0x301B.name: NC_ITEM_PICKOTHER_ACK
fields: handle of the member who receives it
0x301B.notes: to the player who clicked, only when the receiver is someone else; the 2016 client has no handler (C01: dropped)

0x1C0C.name: NC_BRIEFINFO_MAGICFIELDSPREAD_CMD
0x1C0C.basis: zone BriefInformationMagicField ctor FUN_00549330 (length 0x12), filled in ShineMagicField::so_mgcfld_MagicFieldSpread FUN_0057ea30 / _Friend FUN_0057ee80, sent by vt 0x4c8 (folded FUN_00555280); client GameFrameWork::On_NC_BRIEFINFO_MAGICFIELDSPREAD_CMD FUN_004a09b0 → MagicField::AddMagicField FUN_00611a60; layout = pdb2016 PROTO struct
fields: ActiveSkill ID of the field skill
ActiveSkill.Area / 2 (the client does not use it)
0x1C0C.notes: 16 bytes; to every player in sight at the spread and to players walking into sight (Z09 §12.6)

0x1C0D.name: NC_BRIEFINFO_MAGICFIELDINFO_CMD
0x1C0D.notes: never sent by the 2016 zone: the batch counter is never incremented (original bug Z09-B27)

0x1C0F.name: NC_BRIEFINFO_BUILDDOOR_CMD
0x1C0F.basis: zone BriefInformationDoor ctor FUN_00549260 (length 0x32), ShineDoor::so_door_Build FUN_0043f7b0 / so_door_DoorAction FUN_00550770 fill it, sent by ShineDoor::so_SendMyBriefInfo FUN_00555b60; client On_NC_BRIEFINFO_BUILDDOOR_CMD FUN_004a0a60
fields: MobInfo ID of the door model
x, y (u32 each), u8 dir (2° units)
DA_CLOSE 0, DA_OPEN 1, DA_BREAK 2 (client: 0 closed, 1/2 open, other ignored)
32-byte .sbi door block name; empty until the first so_door_DoorAction (Z09-B33)

0x1C10.name: NC_BRIEFINFO_DOOR_CMD
0x1C10.basis: zone BriefInfoExchangeDoor::bixd_Send FUN_0043d7d0 (length 3 + 0x30·n), bixd_Exchange FUN_0043ff60; client On_NC_BRIEFINFO_DOOR_CMD FUN_004a0b00

0x1C11.name: NC_BRIEFINFO_EFFECTBLAST_CMD
0x1C11.basis: zone BriefInformationEffect ctor FUN_005491f0 (length 0x32), ShineEffectObject::so_effect_EffectBlast FUN_004b1540 / FUN_004b1770; client On_NC_BRIEFINFO_EFFECTBLAST_CMD FUN_004bd900 → EffectObjectMgr::AddEffectObject FUN_004c4560
fields: followed object's handle, 0xFFFF = placed at coord

0x1C12.name: NC_BRIEFINFO_EFFECT_CMD
0x1C12.basis: zone BriefInfoExchangeEffect::bixe_Send FUN_0043d900 (length 3 + 0x30·n); client On_NC_BRIEFINFO_EFFECT_CMD FUN_004bd920

0x6C09.name: NC_SCENARIO_DOORSTATE_CMD
0x6C09.basis: zone ShineDoor::so_door_DoorAction FUN_00550770 (broadcast to the map); client On_NC_SCENARIO_DOORSTATE_CMD FUN_004a3510
0x6C09.notes: the client switches its own door block by the name stored from the last 0x1C0F/0x1C10 (Z09-B33); Z09 §13.1

0x243C.name: NC_BAT_DOTDAMAGE_CMD
0x243C.basis: zone AxialListMobSuicide::alms_SelfKill FUN_004f1720 (broadcast in sight, length 0xF); client FUN_004b5740
0x243C.notes: only the self-kill send site of Z09 (cMobSuicide / ShineSuicide / servant vanish, §13.3); the DoT send sites belong to Z03

0x6C16.name: NC_SCENARIO_TIMER_CMD
0x6C16.basis: zone cTimer FUN_005dd310 (all players of a map), cTimer_Obj FUN_005dd4b0 (one player); client GameFrameWork::On_NC_SCENARIO_TIMER_CMD FUN_0049d100
fields: Lua argument 2; the client resets the instance-dungeon time window (IDTimeWin::ResetTime)

0x6C21.name: NC_SCENARIO_TIMER_START_CMD
0x6C21.basis: zone cTimerStart FUN_005eb5a0; client FUN_004a62c0 (EventTimeWin::Start + show)
fields: PROTO struct is empty (C++ size 1); the byte is not written, stale buffer content
0x6C21.notes: to one player (handle) or every player of a map (map name), Z09 §14.6

0x6C22.name: NC_SCENARIO_TIMER_END_CMD
0x6C22.notes: to one player or every player of a map, Z09 §14.6

0x2074.name: NC_ACT_ANIMATION_START_CMD
0x2074.basis: zone ShinePlayer::sp_CreateCastingBar FUN_005762a0 (Lua cCastingBar); client FUN_0049d120 (Char::ActAction)
fields: animation name from the script, also stored in the player's brief info

0x2075.name: NC_ACT_ANIMATION_STOP_CMD
0x2075.basis: zone ShinePlayer::sp_Schedule_CastingBar FUN_00576100, sp_CastingBarFree FUN_00570bd0; client FUN_0049d150 (stops the current action only if its name equals sAnimationIndex)
fields: the running animation at the timer end; always "" from sp_CastingBarFree (Z09-B37)

0x6C05.name: NC_SCENARIO_AREAENTRY_REQ
0x6C05.basis: zone PineEventScriptNode::ShineInterruptSet::sa_Step FUN_004ec1e0 (interruptset areaentry), sent to every object in the map of the theater's centre flag; client GameFrameWork::On_NC_SCENARIO_AREAENTRY_REQ FUN_004be410 → AreaInfoMgr::AddRequestAreaTest(area, 1)
fields: area name from the map's .aid (strncpy, zero-padded); Name8 in PROTO_NC_SCENARIO_AREAENTRY_REQ
0x6C05.notes: the client tests its own position every frame and answers 0x6C06 when inside once, then drops the request

0x6C07.name: NC_SCENARIO_AREALEAVE_REQ
0x6C07.basis: zone PineEventScriptNode::ShineInterruptSet::sa_Step FUN_004ec1e0 (interruptset arealeave), sent to every object in the map of the theater's centre flag; client GameFrameWork::On_NC_SCENARIO_AREALEAVE_REQ FUN_004be450 → AreaInfoMgr::AddRequestAreaTest(area, 2)
fields: area name from the map's .aid (strncpy, zero-padded); Name8 in PROTO_NC_SCENARIO_AREALEAVE_REQ
0x6C07.notes: the client tests its own position every frame and answers 0x6C08 when outside once, then drops the request

0x2011.name: NC_ACT_NOTICE_CMD
0x2011.basis: zone ShinePlayer::so_ply_Notice FUN_005977e0 (disassembly); client: accepted and ignored in every scene (C01)
fields: never written: whatever the shared send buffer held (Z09-B54)
no terminating NUL on the wire; total size = len + 4
0x2011.notes: sent by NPCAction NoticeAction (no 2016 trigger uses it) and the Lua observer (§14.7); no struct in either PDB

0x111A.name: NC_CHAR_TUTORIAL_FREESTAT_INIT_REQ
0x111A.basis: zone cFreeStatInit FUN_005e7dc0; character server FUN_00429c90 (D02)
fields: never written: stale g_buf byte (Z09-B58); D02 ignores it
0x111A.notes: answer 0x111B (Z07 §2); the zone locks sp_bCharFreeStatLock meanwhile

0x1812.name: NC_MAP_FREEPKZONE_ON_CMD
0x1812.notes: no payload; client shows 'This area is enabled for PvP.' (Z09 §17.6)

0x182B.name: NC_MAP_CAN_USE_REVIVEITEM_CMD
0x182B.basis: zone cSetCanUseReviveItem FUN_005e8520, ShinePlayer::so_ply_SendCanUseReviveItem FUN_005616f0; client FUN_0049d9a0
0x182B.notes: map-wide from the Lua setter, per player from so_ply_SendCanUseReviveItem (Z09 §17.6)

0x207C.name: NC_ACT_EVENT_CODE_ACTION_CMD
0x207C.basis: zone cActByEventCode FUN_005eaa70 via cLuaBroadcast FUN_005d8030; client FUN_004a6300
fields: client plays action (code/10000)*10000 with sub (code/100 mod 100)*100

0x6C0D.name: NC_SCENARIO_ANIMATE_CMD
0x6C0D.notes: sight without the mob; the client stops the current animation first (Z09 §17.2). Also sent by Pine ShineAnimate (part 15)

0x6C18.name: NC_SCENARIO_MAP_OBJECT_CONTROL_CMD
0x6C18.basis: zone cMapObjectControl FUN_005e2ad0 (len 0x27 with opcode); client FUN_004a6650; pdb2016 struct
fields: Lua arg 3; client type 0: 0 = hide, else show; type 1: fade target
0x6C18.notes: to every object of the map (so_AllInMap of the axial flag); no zone state, late joiners do not get it (Z09 §17.2)

0x6C1C.name: NC_SCENARIO_HIDE_OTHER_PLAYER_CMD
fields: 1 hide the other players, 0 show them
0x6C1C.notes: to one player through its data stream (vt 0x2f8) (Z09 §17.2)

0xBC1C.name: NC_GAMBLE_ENTER_PLAYER_DIRECT_CMD
0xBC1C.basis: zone ShineObject::so_DirectInfoBroadcast FUN_00553510 (cSetObjectDirect FUN_005e8fa0, mob skill facing); client MHDiceGameTask FUN_007069b0
0xBC1C.notes: face-direction broadcast reused outside the gamble house; only the dice-game task handles it on the client (Z09 §17.2)

0x207B.name: NC_ACT_OBJECT_EFFECT_CMD
0x207B.basis: zone cObjectEffect FUN_005ea8b0 (cLuaBroadcast to sight); client GameFrameWork::On_NC_ACT_OBJECT_EFFECT_CMD FUN_004b6fa0; pdb2016 struct
fields: Lua arg 2; the client reads it as u16 = ActionEffectInfo row
0x207B.notes: Lua-only; to the object's sight incl. itself (Z09 §18.6)

0x207A.name: NC_ACT_OBJECT_SOUND_CMD
0x207A.basis: zone cObjectSound FUN_005ea6f0 (to sight); client On_NC_ACT_OBJECT_SOUND_CMD FUN_0049d4d0; pdb2016 struct
fields: 32 bytes copied from the Lua string regardless of its length (Z09-B64)
0x207A.notes: Lua-only; client plays the file at the object's position (Z09 §18.6)

0x6C17.name: NC_SCENARIO_MAPMARK_CMD
0x6C17.basis: zone cMapMark FUN_005df860, cMapMark_Obj FUN_005dffc0, cMapMark_FieldSight FUN_005e0640; client On_NC_SCENARIO_MAPMARK_CMD FUN_0049d1c0 → MiniMapWin::AddMapMark FUN_0054ead0; pdb2016 struct
fields: 15 bytes each: u16 nGroup (+0), u32 nCoord.x (+2), u32 nCoord.y (+6), u8 eMapIcon MiniMapIconType (+10), u32 nKeepTime ms (+11)
0x6C17.notes: to the map, to the players in sight of (x, y), or to one player; the client replaces a mark with the same nGroup (Z09 §18.6)
